latest.title: Building AI Agents Using Amazon Nova Pro and Strands SDK
latest.description: In this article, I share my experience completing the AWS User Group Madurai Strands Agents Workshop and Challenge Sprint. I built multiple AI agents using Strands SDK, Amazon Nova Pro, Amazon Bedrock, memory systems, custom tools, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. Through five hands-on challenges, I explored agent development, tool calling, memory management, streaming responses, and AWS documentation retrieval using MCP-powered agents.

latest.title: Cerberus: A Three-Headed Static Analysis Agent for Code Security, Logic, and Architecture
latest.description: Most static analysis tools solve one problem well. Security scanners find vulnerabilities. Linters catch style issues. Architecture review tools surface cloud anti-patterns. But production incidents rarely have a single cause. This is the gap Cereberus addresses.

latest.title: Computação de Borda (Edge Computing): Personalização Dinâmica em Tempo Real com Amazon CloudFront e Lambda@Edge
latest.description: O artigo detalha a supressão da latência intercontinental na entrega de conteúdo dinâmico através da integração do Amazon CloudFront com funções Lambda@Edge. Direcionado a engenheiros de software seniores, o material orienta a construção de motores de personalização e testes A/B globais ancorados no Amazon DynamoDB Global Tables, garantindo taxas massivas de acerto de cache (cache hit ratio) sem sacrificar a individualização da experiência do usuário.

Migrating Legacy Banking Data to AWS: 
Building Self-Healing Ingestion Pipelines without Rewriting Core Systems
latest.description: Learn how to migrate decades-old mainframe banking systems to AWS without rewriting core applications. trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
